programme.title: Come Dine with Me: The...

programme.desc: Sight Gag: Carrie's upset when she finds out that she needs glasses, so Doug buys her discount laser eye surgery.

programme.title: The King of Queens
programme.desc: Mean Streak: Can Doug break Iggy Stenkowski's 18-year record of 951 consecutive perfect delivery days? Carrie doesn't get why the dog walker likes spending time with Arthur.

programme.title: Everybody Loves Raymond
programme.desc: A Job for Robert: Ray's jealous when Marie starts treating Robert better than him.

programme.title: Everybody Loves Raymond

programme.title: Everybody Loves Raymond
programme.desc: Favors: Marie helps Debra to deal with Ray's bad habit of leaving his stuff lying around the house.

programme.title: Frasier
programme.desc: Bla-Z-Boy: An accident leaves a mess on Frasier's carpet and breaks Martin's chair. Niles gives piano lessons to a talented Roz and a not-so-talented Daphne.

programme.title: Frasier
programme.desc: The Two Hundredth Episode: Frasier celebrates his 200th radio broadcast and has tapes of every show - except one. Can any of his obsessive fans help? Bill Gates guest stars.

programme.title: Frasier
programme.desc: Sharing Kirby: Frasier and Niles befriend Kirby when they learn that his girlfriend's grandfather is a well-known wine connoisseur.

programme.desc: Wrexham v Cardiff City (Kick-off 8.00pm). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the fourth-round match at StoK Racecourse, as the Welsh rivals face each other for the first time since the 2001/02 season. Big-spending Wrexham were minutes away from being eliminated by Hull City in the first round, but an injury-time brace from Ollie Palmer inspired them to a penalty shootout victory, before they went on to defeat Preston North End and Reading in the following rounds. Meanwhile, the Bluebirds registered routine wins over Swindon Town and Cheltenham Town before recording a cup upset over Premier League Burnley in round three, with first-half goals by Joel Colwill and Callum Robinson inspiring a 2-1 triumph at Turf Moor. Commentary comes from Sam Matterface and Stephen Warnock, with analysis by Steven Fletcher and Robert Earnshaw, and reports from Gabriel Clarke
